panel_description_zh: 中景平视，妻子拿起包准备出门；脸是 3/4 侧面，能看到蹙眉；一只手已搭在门把手上；背景玄关、鞋柜、门外隐约可见走廊。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 买衣服?我妈衣服都给她买多到一天一换都穿不过来，下次还是给钱吧，哪里需要买什么衣服，莫名其妙的假孝心。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot of a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman in the entryway reaching for her small crossbody bag with one hand while the other hand is already on the front door brushed-silver handle ready to push it open. Face shown in three-quarter side view, eyebrows drawn down and inward at the bridge in a settled scowl, eyes narrowed, mouth closed with lips pressed together, jaw clenched. Long straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline. Fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top tucked into light grey high-waisted yoga leggings, fluffy-cuff light grey memory-foam house slippers, fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the hand on the door handle. Background: entryway shoe cabinet, a pair of white sneakers on the floor waiting to be switched into, the dim hallway light visible through the partially open door. Hallway ceiling light warm white. Mood: a sharp remark disguised as casual conversation, the puncturing 'fake filial piety' line. Text watermark 'P06-PN02' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in the room, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, bloodshot eyes
